source_refs.note: iv) Chalcogens: a main subheading of 1.5 Families in the periodic table, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 5-5.

blocks.text: Group 16 ke elements Chalcogens kehlate hain kyun ke copper (Greek mein chalkos) ki zyada tar ores (khaam dhaat) oxides ya sulfides hoti hain. Is group mein oxygen aur sulfur non-metals hain, Se, Te aur Po ko kitab metalloids kehti hai, aur livermorium (Lv) metal hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “Rivernorium” chhapa hai. Aisa koi element nahi; sahi naam livermorium (Lv, element 116) hai, jo group 16 ke sab se neeche hai.
